name: The Park Circular Walk at Ankerwycke
summary: National Trust's circular trail, about 1 km, from Ankerwycke, Magna Carta Lane.
notes: Route line from OpenStreetMap, built on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it, so surfaces and barriers are as mapped, not as found.

The trail is National Trust's. Check their page on the day for opening times, parking, livestock and conditions: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/surrey/runnymede-and-ankerwycke/the-park-circular-walk-at-ankerwycke
review: 4 places where the mapped paths don't join; the route may be incomplete or out of order in OpenStreetMap
